concept_gloss.applicability: İki tanıklanan yapının ortak yönü, alan ayrıntıları açıklanarak birlikte özetleneceği zaman kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Olgun ve genç üyelerin aynı toplulukta görünür hale gelmesi ortaklığını korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir canlı topluluğunda olgun üyelerle genç üyelerin birlikte belirmesi: deve sürüsünde yavrular annelerinin yanında yetişir; hurmalık büyük ve küçükler diye iki gruba ayrılır.

facets.statement: Olgun üyeler ile genç veya küçük üyeler aynı topluluk içinde birlikte bulunur.
Deve sürüsünde yavrular annelerinin yanında doğup yetişir.
Hurmalık, büyük ve küçük üyelerden oluşan iki gruba ayrılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Develerin yavrularının anneleriyle birlikte büyüdüğünü bildiren yapıya özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Yavruların varlığını, annelerle birlikteliğini ve yetişme olayını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hurmalığın büyük ve küçük üyelerden oluşan iki küme haline geldiği yapıya özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Hurmalığın iki boyut veya yaş grubuna ayrılması sonucunu eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.text: büyük ve küçük iki gruba ayrılmak

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ortak sınır olgun ve genç üyelerin birlikte belirmesidir; hurma kullanımı yalnız büyük-küçük grup ayrımını bildirir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi develerde yavruların anneleriyle birlikte yetişmesini, hurmalarda ise topluluğun büyükler ve küçükler diye iki gruba ayrılmasını bildirir. Olgunlarla gençlerin birlikte bulunması ortaklaştırılabilir; ancak hurma tanıklığı doğrudan kökenden çıkma veya anneden sürme işlemi söylemez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: büyük ve küçük iki gruba ayrılmak

lexicalization_scope.note: İki anlam da tanıklanan türemiş yapılara ve kendi canlılık alanlarına bağlıdır; genel bir büyüme veya üreme anlamına genişletilmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; deve yavrusu, anneyi izleyen yavru ve genç hurma sürgünüyle sınırı en iyi açan üç ilişki seçildi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı sürüde yavruların anneleri yanında yetişmesi olayını anlatır; komşu dal ise öncelikle yavrunun kendisini ve annesini izlemesini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Deve yavrularının anneleri yanında yetişmesi olayını ve hurmalardaki iki grup kullanımını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Deve yavrusunu veya annesini izleyen yavruları ad olarak belirtir ve koyun doğumuna da uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal deve yavrularının anneleriyle birlikte bulunması sahnesinde belirgin biçimde örtüşür.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında topluluğun büyük-küçük diye gruplanması vardır; komşu dalda ise tek genç sürgünün ana bitkiden ayrılması ve bağımsızlaşması belirleyicidir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hurmalığın büyük ve küçük üyelerden oluşan iki grup haline gelmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tek bir genç hurma sürgününün ana bitkiden ayrılıp bağımsızlaşmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal olgun hurmalarla genç hurmalar arasındaki ilişkiyi konu edinir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı yavruların sürüde anneleriyle birlikte belirmesini bildiren olaydır; komşu dal ise bu olayın katılımcısı olan yavruyu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yavruların anneleri yanında yetişmesi olayını ve ayrıca hurmalardaki grup ayrımını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Devenin ilk dönem yavrusunu doğrudan bir varlık adı olarak belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal deve yavrusunun yaşamın ilk dönemindeki durumuna temas eder.

source_note.JA: Develerde yavruların anneleri yanında yetişmesi ile hurmaların büyük ve küçük iki gruba ayrılması birlikte tanıklanır.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, tapınılan nesne; güçlenme ve kalıcılık; miktarı artırma, çok edinme veya bol verme; olgunlarla gençlerin aynı toplulukta belirmesi olmak üzere dört ayrı anlam alanına yayılır.

text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْثَٰنًۭا وَتَخْلُقُونَ إِفْكًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًۭا فَٱبْتَغُوا۟ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرِّزْقَ وَٱعْبُدُوهُ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ ۖ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

baseline.text: Siz Allah'ı bırakıp yalnızca putlara kulluk ediyor ve bir yalan uyduruyorsunuz. Allah'ı bırakıp kulluk ettikleriniz size hiçbir rızık sağlayamaz. Öyleyse rızkı Allah katında arayın, O'na kulluk edin ve O'na şükredin. Yalnız O'na döndürüleceksiniz.

findings.text: Putların fiziksel ve toplumsal sabitliği, rızık üzerinde tasarruf gücü sanılan sahte bir dayanıklılıktır.
Yalan uydurmak, ilahi ölçülü yaratılışı taklit eden fakat atfı ve yönelişi gerçekten saptıran sahte bir üretimdir.

activation_trace.role: Humble obedience supplies the enacted dependency whose proper object the repeated verbs relocate.
Ownership with power of disposal supplies the precise capacity denied to the substitutes.
An allotted gift or benefit is the dependency-bearing good first denied and then redirected.
Active seeking makes the redirection a practical pursuit rather than a bare doctrinal correction.
Recognition of benefit closes the chain by assigning the gift to its actual giver.

changed_reading.after: The ayah exposes a patronage error: people submit where they imagine sustenance is controlled, while the supposed patrons possess no such capacity; seeking, service, and acknowledgment must therefore follow the real provision relation.
changed_reading.before: The ayah contrasts worshiping idols with worshiping and thanking God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَعْبُدُونَ / لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًا / فَٱبْتَغُوا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرِّزْقَ وَٱعْبُدُوهُ وَٱشْكُرُوا لَهُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah audits worship through dependency: submission treats its object as master and sustaining patron. It denies the substitutes any ownership or disposal of the allotted benefit, then reallocates seeking, service, and gratitude to the giver.

activation_trace.role: Fabricating false speech supplies the explicit human production of the counterfeit account.
Estimating and shaping supplies the constructive process by which the false account is fitted into a usable form.
Turning something away from its proper direction supplies the reversal between creator, artifact, and worshiper.
A lie diverted from truth identifies the manufactured product as a counter-reality, not neutral craft.
Apparent strength and fixity explain how the artifact can be granted durable standing despite being made.

changed_reading.after: They manufacture a stable-seeming counter-reality and then inhabit its inverted hierarchy: the makers become servants of what they themselves have fixed in place.
changed_reading.before: They make idols and tell lies about them.

baseline_models.mechanism: The addressees do not merely repeat a false statement. They form a counterfeit account, give a made object the fixed standing of a god, and then submit to their own product, reversing maker and made.

activation_trace.role: Nearness that falls short of the endpoint supplies the image of an attractive but terminally inadequate stop.
Otherness and lower rank mark the substitutes as displaced alternatives rather than rival sources.
Nearness and presence provide the positive destination for seeking.
Return to an originating direction closes the spatial and existential vector.

changed_reading.after: The verse maps misdirected dependence as stopping short: its imperatives resume movement toward the true source, while the final passive return declares that every substitute route ends at God anyway.
changed_reading.before: The verse says to abandon other gods, ask God for provision, and remember the final return.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ... فَٱبْتَغُوا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ... إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah draws a directional sequence. The substitutes occupy a position short of or other than the goal; provision is sought in God's presence and authority; return terminates every detour at the originating destination.

activation_trace.role: Humble obedience is the focus anchor whose practical allegiance is being tested.
Assaying metal or a person supplies pressure as the means by which declared allegiance becomes observable.
Compliance and obedience identify the concrete behavior withheld from coercive kin.
Association with God names the boundary at which ordinary relational obedience becomes rival allegiance.

changed_reading.after: Worship is the allegiance that survives pressure and governs obedience; the focus asks not only what is ritually addressed but which claimant becomes master when loyalty costs something.
changed_reading.before: Worship is a ritual act directed to the wrong object.

context_deltas.mechanism: Whole-surah pressure turns worship from a label into an assay of effective obedience. Profession is tested, and even intimate authority may not be obeyed when it recruits one into association; the focus verbs therefore identify the master actually followed under cost.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies profession under assay and a command not to obey coercive parents into association; I infer that pressure reveals the operative object of service. A live alternative is that ع ب د remains primarily cultic while obedience is only an analogy.
structural_cues: 29:2 places testing immediately after the verbal claim of belief.
29:8 joins family pressure, refusal of obedience, return, and disclosure of deeds.

activation_trace.role: Power of possession and disposal is the focus capacity against which the patrons' promise is audited.
Allotted benefit supplies the positive side of the promised patronage relation.
Following behind supplies recruitment into dependence on the speakers' route.
A traversable extended road makes the offered allegiance a directed social course.
Guarantee and surety expose the speakers' offer as a liability-transfer contract that they cannot perform.
Weight supplies the nontransferable and compounding liability concealed by the offer.
Invented falsehood identifies the guarantee itself as manufactured patronage.

changed_reading.after: The focus audits every patronage claim attached to allegiance: false masters cannot secure benefits or absorb the liabilities by which they recruit dependents.
changed_reading.before: The idols cannot give material provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The invitation to follow a group's path is marketed with a guarantee to carry another's liabilities, but the guarantors cannot transfer the burden and instead acquire additional weight. This revises the focus's powerless providers into false patrons who promise both benefit and risk absorption without possessing either.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recruitment, a surety promise, its failure, and compounded burdens; I infer an analogy between promised liability absorption and promised sustenance. The alternative is that the burden episode concerns only moral accountability, not economic patronage.
structural_cues: 29:12 repeats carrying in promise and denial; 29:13 answers with each party's own loads plus added loads.
The focus similarly places claimed allegiance beside an explicit denial of the patron's operative capacity.

activation_trace.role: Fabricating a lie anchors the focus's human pseudo-creation.
A lie diverted from truth identifies the product's false ontological claim.
Opening and initiating supply the generative capacity absent from the fabricated counter-world.
Return after departure supplies re-creation as a second test of genuine creative power.
Stable correspondence with reality places divine creation on the opposite side of the focus's إفك.
Making a thing extends the focus's charge from speech into observable human production.
Cutting together an invented lie names the terminal form of counterfeit authorship.

changed_reading.after: The phrase accuses them of counterfeit creation: they compose a social-religious reality that mimics creative authority while lacking the power to originate, restore, or ground anything in truth.
changed_reading.before: تخلقون إفكًا means that the addressees invent a lie.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah separates origination, re-creation, and truth-grounded creation from human making and fabrication. The focus's تخلقون إفكًا becomes counterfeit world-production: a made account borrows the grammar of creation but cannot begin, sustain, or restore what is real.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine beginning and return, creation with truth, human making, and fabricated lying; I infer a polemic between reality-producing creation and counterfeit world-making. The live alternative is the narrower sense 'compose a lie' without an ontological contrast.
structural_cues: 29:19-20 repeat beginning, creation, return, and new origination just after the focus.
29:44 pairs God's creation with truth; 29:45 closes with God's knowledge of what people make; 29:68 pairs fabrication with lying against God.

activation_trace.role: Diversion from a proper direction anchors falsehood as a vector rather than only a proposition.
Return to the originating direction supplies the focus's terminal counter-movement.
Turning a thing from its face makes the coming reversal of orientation explicit.
Subjection of the cosmos to a purpose supplies acknowledged ordered agency before the irrational turn away.
The passive turning-away applies the focus root to the worshipers themselves and reveals misorientation as something enacted upon them.

changed_reading.after: إفك is also lived misdirection that turns knowing agents toward powerless objects; the final return announces an unavoidable reorientation to the source they displaced.
changed_reading.before: إفك is the lie they manufacture, and return is a separate warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later turns إفك from a false object into a directional condition: people acknowledge the creator and cosmic order yet are passively turned away. The focus's final return, reinforced by being turned back to God, becomes the counterturn that defeats this misorientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acknowledged cosmic authorship, passive diversion, and passive return/counterturn; I infer one directional mechanism linking cognition, worship, and destiny. An alternative is that the passive verbs merely share eschatological rhetoric without forming a deliberate vector pair.
structural_cues: 29:21 closely echoes the focus's return with the stronger image 'you are turned over/back.'
29:61 juxtaposes explicit acknowledgment that God created and ordered the cosmos with 'how are they turned away?'

activation_trace.role: Strength and fixity supply the idols' apparent capacity to stabilize a collective.
A mainstay on which an affair rests supplies the support function that the focus denies.
Affection supplies the interpersonal adhesive explicitly associated with taking the idols.
A connection standing between parties makes the idol-mediated bond structurally legible.
Expulsion under anger supplies the final reversal of the bond into mutual exclusion.
Love, support, and alliance identify what the substitute network is expected to provide.
The web-weaving spider supplies a constructed network whose many connections can look like infrastructure.
Shelter and dwelling supply the protective function claimed for the network.
Loss of strength supplies the hidden engineering verdict on the apparent shelter.

changed_reading.after: The focus also dismantles idol-mediated social insurance: the objects stabilize a network of affection and alliance, but that apparent support-house cannot own provision and disintegrates when protection is needed.
changed_reading.before: The focus rejects stone cult objects because they cannot provide food.

context_deltas.mechanism: Idols function as social infrastructure. Shared affection binds people around them, allies promise nearness and support, and the resulting network resembles a built shelter; its apparent fixity masks structural weakness, exposed when mutual affection reverses into repudiation and expulsion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies idols as mutual affection, substitute allies, a woven house, weakness, and later reciprocal expulsion; I infer that the idols mediate a coalition whose social insurance is part of their claimed provision. The concrete cult object remains a live referent rather than being dissolved into sociology.
structural_cues: 29:25 repeats the focus's idols and 'apart from God,' then glosses their worldly function as affection between the group.
29:25 predicts reciprocal repudiation and cursing; 29:41 converts substitute allies into the surah's spider-house comparison.

activation_trace.role: Measured shaping anchors the focus's constructive work of fitting the falsehood into form.
Displaying something as beautiful supplies the persuasive surface applied to the community's deeds.
Turning away and obstructing supplies the behavioral effect of the attractive fabrication.
The extended road supplies the true course from which beautified practice diverts.
Inner discernment makes the diversion surprising: plausibility can redirect even where some insight remains.
Skilled workmanship sharpens the lie as an artifact of practiced human production.

changed_reading.after: The lie is also a designed plausibility system: repeated actions are shaped and beautified until they obstruct another route even for people capable of seeing.
changed_reading.before: The lie is a false proposition attached to an idol.

context_deltas.mechanism: Counterfeit reality is maintained by presentation and practice. Actions are beautified, that attractive surface blocks the road, and even people possessing sight remain diverted; the focus's 'creating a lie' thus includes skilled production of plausibility, not only saying an untruth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beautification, obstruction, a road, retained sight, and skilled making; I infer a causal arrow from crafted attractiveness to durable misdirection. The live alternative is that Satanic beautification and the focus's تخلقون are parallel but independent descriptions.
structural_cues: 29:38 sequences beautified deeds, obstruction from the road, and continued possession of sight.
29:45 ends a practice-centered passage by naming what the addressees manufacture.

activation_trace.role: Presence and nearness anchor the focus's 'at God' as relation to a source.
Rain descending as provision supplies a dynamic life-bearing form of the focus noun.
Manifest signs also being 'at God' shows the formula marking authoritative possession or provenance, not a physical warehouse.
Visible carrying supplies the negated storage model: the moving creature does not bear its provision inventory.
Spreading and extension supply provision's variable outward flow.
Constriction to a measured amount supplies the opposite modulation of that flow.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the material carrier of life-giving provision.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation supplies the realized effect of provision's circulation.

changed_reading.after: Seek from God as the authority of a mobile, measured, life-making circulation; the contrast is not between two warehouses but between the giver's active flow and substitutes with no control over it.
changed_reading.before: Seek food from God because idols have none stored to give.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated formula 'at God' marks authoritative provenance, while later provision is something a moving creature need not carry, something expanded or narrowed, and something descending as water that revives land. Seeking provision at God therefore means entering the giver's circulation rather than locating an inert stockpile.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated provenance formula, non-carrying creatures, modulation of provision, and water-to-life sequence; I infer that provision is a governed circulation rather than a hoard. A live alternative is that 'at God' remains ordinary locative rhetoric and رزق primarily names concrete food.
structural_cues: 29:50 repeats عِندَ ٱللَّهِ for signs, extending the focus formula beyond food.
29:60-63 sequence non-carrying creatures, divine providing, expansion and constriction, then rain and revived earth.

activation_trace.role: Recognizing and displaying a benefaction anchors gratitude as correct attribution to the giver.
Praise opposite blame supplies the voiced acknowledgment after water and revived earth.
Purity after mixture supplies crisis-induced clearing of rival attributions.
Reassociation after rescue supplies the relapse that gratitude must prevent.
Good condition and blessing identify security itself as delivered benefit.
Covering a blessing supplies the precise failure of provenance once safety feels ordinary.

changed_reading.after: Gratitude is the discipline that keeps provision attached to its source after crisis passes; without it, benefit becomes ordinary, its giver is covered, and dependence is reassigned to substitutes.
changed_reading.before: After receiving provision, people should thank God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence distinguishes momentary correct attribution from durable gratitude. Peril strips devotion clean, rescue is followed by renewed association, and secure blessing is then covered over; شكر in the focus is the practice of preserving the giver-benefit relation after delivery and safety.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies praise after provision, purified crisis-devotion, post-rescue association, and covered blessing; I infer that shukr is durable source-recognition across changing conditions. The alternative is a narrower command to verbal thanks accompanied by worship.
structural_cues: 29:63 moves from rain and revived land to الحمد لله.
29:65-67 move from danger and exclusive devotion through rescue to renewed association, then contrast belief in falsehood with covering God's blessing.

remaining_uncertainties: The social-infrastructure reading should not erase the concrete idol referent.
The circulation sense of provision is strongly patterned but does not by itself settle how active seeking relates to material labor.
The paved-route and productive-uptake readings depend on remote branch images and should remain explicitly exploratory.
strongest_changes: The focus's worship-provision contrast became an audit of effective patronage: allegiance follows imagined control of benefit and risk.
تخلقون إفكًا became counterfeit world-production, sharpened by divine beginning, re-creation, and creation with truth.
The idols became mediators of a fragile social support-house built from affection and alliance, not merely isolated cult objects.
Provision became governed circulation and gratitude became durable preservation of its provenance after safety returns.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah repetition linked the focus's compact sequence of making, serving, owning, seeking, thanking, and returning into one directional system: humans construct plausible support relations, inhabit them as dependents, and are finally reoriented toward the actual source. The spider-house and the late provision-rain-rescue sequence supplied the most consequential activations.

activation_trace.role: A leveled, repeatedly traveled road supplies worship as habit that makes one course easy to traverse.
Routes scattering in every direction supply the centrifugal alternative produced by rival services.
Diversion and obstruction show a false practice actively closing access to a route.
The extended traveled way gives the route metaphor an explicit surah-level object.
Gentle direction to a road supplies the positive reorientation achieved through striving.
Plural extended paths keep divine guidance from collapsing into a single material track.

changed_reading.after: Repeated service also paves a route of dependency: false worship makes a misdirected course habitual, while the imperative to worship God begins repaving movement toward the return.
changed_reading.before: Worship consists of discrete acts offered to an object.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The paved-road and scattered-route images are form-distant from ordinary cultic worship, so this should be rendered as a spatial activation rather than a lexical replacement. It remains anchored in the repeated ع ب د of the focus and is reinforced by the surah's obstruction and guidance of paths.

activation_trace.role: Rain descending as provision supplies the life-bearing input to the feedback image.
A little feed or rain producing visible thriving supplies gratitude as responsive uptake that manifests the gift.
Fullness and abundant milk supply an intensified image of benefit becoming productive return.
Delivered water supplies the concrete input that reaches an otherwise dead receiver.
Rain-born vegetation makes the receiver's visible revival the effect of correctly received provision.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, gratitude is also the living uptake by which a small delivered good becomes visible flourishing and productive return rather than remaining inert or being attributed elsewhere.
changed_reading.before: Gratitude verbally acknowledges provision after it arrives.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The animal-feeding, greening, milk, and rain images are cross-domain branch activations, not substitutes for the normal meaning 'give thanks.' They remain anchored in the focus's رزق-to-شكر sequence and gain material coherence from the surah's water reviving land; downstream prose should mark the feedback reading as exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Manufactured fixity without causal possession.** و ث ن B001 identifies the worshipped idol, while B002 adds “strength and fixity.” The objects appear fixed enough to anchor worship, yet they cannot possess provision; meanwhile the worshippers “create” a diverted falsehood. I infer that physical or social fixity is mistaken for causal capacity; the ayah reads as severing stable presence from the power to provide.
2. **A fabricated directional turn.** The sequence create إفك → cannot own provision → seek provision with God makes the falsehood spatially directional. The idols do not merely fail a proposition; they turn seeking away from its effective source. The inferred arrow is that false creation redirects desire, so return to God corrects both worship and provisioning routes.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:41 gives the idols' false fixity an architectural analogue, and 29:60 returns provision to God through creatures unable to store it. Together they expose stable-looking shelter and possession as mistaken proxies for causal care.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Idol-making is counterfeit creation that diverts form from truth.** Lexical evidence: `تَخْلُقُون`, root `خ ل ق`, `B007` (fabricating false speech), and `إِفْكًا`, root `ء ف ك`, `B002` (a lie diverted from truth). Structural cue: `29:19-20` reuse `خ ل ق` for measured origination (`B001/B002`) and pair beginning with return. Assigned role: the fixed ayah's creating forms the counterfeit; diversion turns that product away from its proper referent. Abductive move: the packet supplies the same creation-root on both sides; I infer a deliberate contrast between human fabrication and divine proportioned origination. Reading change: the idols are not merely false objects but products of a mimetic creation-process that redirects attribution.

2. **Provision must be sought at the locus of actual disposal.** Lexical evidence: `يَمْلِكُون`, root `م ل ك`, `B002` (ownership and disposal); `رِزْق`, root `ر ز ق`, `B001` (provision as allotted gift); `فَٱبْتَغُوا`, root `ب غ ي`, `B001` (seeking and pursuing); and `عِندَ`, root `ع ن د`, `B004` (proximity and presence). Structural cue: incapacity is followed by a redirected search, worship, gratitude, and return; `29:21-22` then make divine allocation and the absence of other protectors explicit. Assigned role: ownership controls allocation, seeking moves toward its true locus, and gratitude recognizes the source. Abductive move: I infer a dependency chain from disposal to allotment to worship; the packet supplies each link but the causal integration is mine. Reading change: the ayah reorganizes worship around the concrete economy of provision and return.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later activation (`29:61-63`, `29:67`):** People later name God as creator and rain-giver yet remain diverted and trust voidness. Counterfeit creation therefore need not erase factual acknowledgment; it diverts attribution and dependence at the practical point where recognized ownership should govern worship and gratitude.

words.gloss_range: sentence-level restrictive particle exposing the opening diagnosis as exhaustive
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّمَا}} ({{tr:innamā}}) makes the opening more than a charge; it restricts the addressees' present religious activity to idol-service and fabricated falsehood. The dominant particle reading works as sentence-level restriction, while the clause also launches a four-beat movement from exposure to proof, command, and return.
words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)

topics.headline: restrictive opening diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening does not merely report idol worship; it excludes their better self-descriptions by reducing the practice to idols and fabricated falsehood.
topics.reason: The guardrail grammar supports the dominant sentence-level restriction, while the segmentation dispute is kept as a limit rather than allowed to erase the restrictive force.

topics.headline: discourse arc launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first word launches a prosecutorial arc that will move from diagnosis to proof, correction, and final return.
topics.reason: The transition and architecture rows make the restrictive opening the frame for the whole ayah rather than only a local particle note.

words.gloss_range: ongoing second-person plural worship or service directed to idols inside an exclusion frame
words.prose: {{ar:تَعْبُدُونَ}} ({{tr:taʿbudūna}}) keeps the accusation in the present as an ongoing second-person habit. It takes the idols as object while the exclusion phrase marks theological displacement, so worship is both object-choice and movement away from God. The familiar worship-besides-God formula (21:66; 26:75; 37:86) is made concrete here by the idol object. The root range lets the act sound like servitude as well as ritual devotion, and the same root will later be redirected in command form.
words.root_gloss_range: worship, service, servitude, and bondage; locally misdirected devotion is also servitude

topics.headline: ongoing addressed worship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the charge is present, habitual, and aimed at the addressees, not a detached report about others.
topics.reason: The imperfect second-person form, direct object, and exclusion phrase all support an ongoing addressed act.

topics.headline: worship as servitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that idol worship is also cast as bondage, while local grammar still selects the worship-service act.
topics.reason: The root field supports servitude pressure, but the local verb remains the worship/service predicate.

topics.headline: worship root arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this first worship verb begins an ayah-level reversal from accused idol-service to commanded worship of God.
topics.reason: The formula, repeated root, and boundary rows show the worship root carrying the ayah's internal reversal.

words.gloss_range: preposition beginning the compound exclusion phrase
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) begins the exclusion phrase that attaches to the worship verb. Its separation force keeps the phrase from being a flat equivalent of "besides": idol worship is framed as worship away from God, and the same phrase will return in the proof clause.
words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)

topics.headline: exclusion preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first exclusion phrase already combines separation from God with the naming of idol worship.
topics.reason: The preposition starts the compound phrase and is repeated later as a structural refrain.

words.gloss_range: construct head in the compound phrase marking other-than and lower-than relation to God
words.prose: {{ar:دُونِ}} ({{tr:dūni}}) is not only a particle-like slot for "besides". As a construct head governing the divine name, it makes God the benchmark while the idols are positioned as other-than and lower-than. Its repetition later binds the accusation and proof with the same exclusion formula.
words.root_gloss_range: below, beneath, less than, nearer-below, and other-than; locally an exclusion and hierarchy marker

topics.headline: lower benchmark relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase carries hierarchy as well as exclusion: the idols are measured below the divine benchmark.
topics.reason: The construct grammar and root field both support a relational below/other-than force.

topics.headline: repeated exclusion formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same formula first names misdirected worship and later proves the worshipped objects powerless.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and repetition rows make the phrase a structural link across the first two beats.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as genitive benchmark in the first exclusion phrase
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) is the definite benchmark inside the exclusion phrase. The idols are measured against this name, not against an abstract standard. Derivational pressure around devotion or bewilderment remains secondary, while the three occurrences of the divine name make God the fixed reference point as the argument moves from exclusion to denial to source.
words.root_gloss_range: divine name associated with worship and contested derivational pressure; locally the definite divine benchmark

topics.headline: genitive divine benchmark
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exclusion phrase measures the idols against the definite divine name.
topics.reason: The proper noun is governed by the construct head and functions as the phrase's benchmark.

topics.headline: derivational pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that worship-related pressure around the divine name matters because the name stands against worshipped idols, while the local role remains the proper name in genitive position.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is relevant as pressure but does not replace the local proper-name function.

topics.headline: three divine-name pivots
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the divine name recurring at the ayah's pivots: excluded standard, excluded standard again, then provision source.
topics.reason: The repeated divine name anchors the argument's movement across three syntactic environments.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural idols or fixed worship-objects as the exposed object of worship
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْثَٰنًۭا}} ({{tr:awthānan}}) names the worshipped object as an indefinite plural class of fixed idols. The root pressure makes them feel static before the ayah denies them any provision-power, and the rare word belongs to concentrated anti-idol scenes (6:74; 7:138; 22:30). Its recurrence later in the surah (29:25) lets this first exposure anticipate the deeper social attachment around idols.
words.root_gloss_range: fixedness, firmness, and fixed cult-objects; locally inert worship-objects under restriction

topics.headline: indefinite idol object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the restricted worship is directed at a generic plural class of idols rather than one named object.
topics.reason: The accusative object role, broken plural, and indefiniteness define the exposed worship-object class.

topics.headline: fixed inert idols
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that the worshippers fabricate a theology around objects whose very lexical pressure is fixedness and inertia.
topics.reason: The wider idol term and fixedness root pressure suit the local contrast with fabrication and later non-ownership.

topics.headline: marked anti-idol distribution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is distributionally marked for confrontation and returns in the same surah to expose idol attachment (29:25).
topics.reason: The occurrence rows connect this word with concentrated prophetic anti-idol settings and the same-surah development.

words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating fabrication with idol worship
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps fabrication joined to worship as a coordinate act. The first beat therefore contains two charges, not one charge plus a later explanation: they worship idols and, alongside that, fabricate falsehood.
words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)

topics.headline: coordinated accusations
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that worship and fabrication are grammatically bound as simultaneous charges.
topics.reason: The conjunction joins two finite predicates and preserves both charges within the restricted opening.

words.gloss_range: second-person imperfect fabricating or producing falsehood, with creation vocabulary kept audible
words.prose: {{ar:تَخْلُقُونَ}} ({{tr:takhluqūna}}) keeps the same addressees responsible for the manufactured falsehood. The object narrows the verb to fabrication, yet the basic form lets creation vocabulary remain audible, making the lie feel like counterfeit creation. Variant readings intensify, internalize, shift the agency, or test the charge against breach and lagging-behind language, but the local canonical form keeps the accusation broad and direct.
words.root_gloss_range: creating, forming, fashioning, and fabricating; locally the object selects lie-fabrication while preserving counterfeit-creation pressure

topics.headline: addressed fabricators
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same addressed worshippers are held responsible for producing the falsehood.
topics.reason: The canonical second-person imperfect keeps agency on the addressed group.

topics.headline: counterfeit creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that lie-making borrows creation language while the local object keeps fabrication as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The object falsehood selects fabrication, while the root and form preserve creation-language pressure.

topics.headline: variant pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant forms expose possible intensification, internalization, and breach contrasts without replacing the canonical direct accusation.
topics.reason: The variants are useful as apparatus, but the local canonical reading governs the prose.

topics.headline: surah creation contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human fabrication here anticipates the later contrast with divine creating in the same surah (29:61).
topics.reason: The same-surah echo preserves a concrete contrast between fabricated falsehood and divine creating.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative falsehood or inversion manufactured by the preceding verb
words.prose: {{ar:إِفْكًا}} ({{tr:ifkan}}) is the manufactured object of the fabrication verb. Its indefiniteness generalizes the falsehood, and the root image makes the lie an inversion of reality rather than a merely incorrect statement. The overturned-city image and slander usage keep the false theology in the same semantic world as moral and social inversion.
words.root_gloss_range: turning away, inversion, lying, and overturning; locally fabricated falsehood as moral and theological inversion

topics.headline: manufactured falsehood object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that falsehood is the object being produced, generalized as a class rather than named as one isolated lie.
topics.reason: The accusative verbal noun and indefiniteness support falsehood as the manufactured object.

topics.headline: inversion field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lie is pictured as reality turned from its proper orientation, while the local noun still means fabricated falsehood.
topics.reason: The root's inversion and overturned-place field provides image pressure without displacing the local falsehood sense.

topics.headline: falsehood distribution and variant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word belongs to a marked falsehood family spanning slander and theology, while the standard noun keeps the falsehood as the produced object.
topics.reason: The variant and distribution rows add pressure but do not replace the local accusative verbal noun.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle opening the proof clause about idol incapacity
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens the proof clause with emphasis. After the opening diagnosis, this particle makes the denial of idol provision-capacity the asserted news, calibrated to listeners expected to resist the claim.
words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)

topics.headline: emphatic proof clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from accusation to proof, with idol incapacity asserted as the clause's emphasized predicate.
topics.reason: The particle governs the relative pronoun and introduces the denial predicate as emphatic news.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative pronoun identifying the worshipped objects for the denial clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) turns the prior idols into a definite relative head: the ones you worship. The rational plural form grants enough grammatical personhood for the next verb to deny their possession explicitly, so pseudo-personhood is staged only to be stripped of power.
words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)

topics.headline: pseudo-personhood denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the idols are grammatically raised as identifiable actors only so their inability can be denied.
topics.reason: The masculine plural relative pronoun identifies the idols and prepares the plural possession verb.

words.gloss_range: repeated worship verb embedded in a relative clause to identify powerless objects
words.prose: {{ar:تَعْبُدُونَ}} ({{tr:taʿbudūna}}) repeats the same form, but its force changes with syntax.
